name: Torigoe Chinatsu
source:
A cheerful and bright girl who dislikes being indecisive and prefers to clarify things in black and white.

She met the protagonist through a game during their first year of school and they have a somewhat close relationship. They talk to each other casually without being conscious of each other's gender. She is curious and watches over the protagonist's romantic developments.

She has been close friends with Hana since childhood.
